note: The Reset and Resume buttons and the medium id box are gone from the control bar. A ?mlib= or ?resume=1 link still opens a library GIF. Controls now have 10px between them (8px on a phone), all share one height, and wrap instead of overlapping. Every control has a name and tooltip, and there are keyboard shortcuts: 1 for live, 2 for replay, 3 for the love map, Space to pause and ? for help. Touch targets are bigger, a touch or keyboard focus brings the bar back, and pressing a control no longer also toggles fullscreen.
